blurb: Whole-person Acupuncture care, traditional herbal medicine, and Homeopathy, with subspecialties in Fertility, Women's Health, and Neuroacupuncture.
long:
In her Oriental Medicine clinic, Sybil focuses on gentle, intuitive Japanese styles of practice. The Japanese tradition emphasizes hair-thin needles, shallow insertions, moxibustion (a warming treatment involving artemesia herb), and extensive palpation techniques. This type of acupuncture benefits all but is especially welcome to those who fear needling or who are extremely sensitive.
Japanese acupuncture also features an herbal medicine tradition, called Kampo, based on the classics. Sophisticated palpation of the abdomen is key to determining a patient’s precise pattern of disharmony and to prescribing the most appropriate herbal formula for each individual.
The AcuGraph system is an invaluable aid in your treatment at Lotus Wellspring Healthcare. A simple test that involves touching a probe to specific points on your wrists, ankles, fingers, or toes shows you—in vivid color and real time—which energy pathways and organs are out of balance and how best to bring everything back into balance.

blurb:
Dr. Nibodhi has spent over 30 years giving private consultations to more than 30,000 people. As a Traditional Naturopath and Ayurvedic Practitioner, he supports people in transforming their health and consciousness.

Drawing on Ayurveda, Vedic sciences, Yoga, Compassionate Inquiry, Jyotish and traditional naturopathy, he supports physical, emotional, and spiritual well-being. His approach helps cultivate balance, clarity, and resilience in body, mind, and Self.

Each session is personalized. Dr. Nibodhi meets people with respect and attentiveness, creating a supportive space for meaningful healing and growth. His guidance is thoughtful, practical, and grounded in decades of experience.
long:
Personal guidance, built around you.

Every appointment starts with deep listening. Dr. Nibodhi takes time to understand the full picture of your needs. He focuses on identifying the root cause and creates a protocol tailored to your constitution and individual needs.

Ayurvedic - A full evaluation of your constitution, current state of balance, and the root causes driving your symptoms.

Vedic medical astrology - Your birth chart read through the lens of health. Identifying innate tendencies and what your body & mind need right now.

Physical diagnostics - Tongue, nail, and eye analysis to assess organ function, digestive strength, and systemic imbalances.

Emotional mapping -A compassionate look at how stress, emotional and mental patterns are affecting your physical health.

Personalized protocol - Specific dietary guidelines, herbs, breathwork, meditation, and daily routines designed for your constitution.

A detailed report. Your protocol, insights, and next steps.
